name: agent-gateway
description: Use your GitHub Copilot models in any agent through one local gateway, share them across machines, and enable web search, compatible with all tool calls. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI, Kilo Code, Cline, DeepSeek Harness, Pi, Oh My Pi, Hermes and OpenClaw.

agentGateway.port.description: Loopback listener port. Development builds always use 24445.

agentGateway.remoteUpstreams.description: Named remote gateways, usually reached through dev tunnels. Remote models are advertised as {name}--{modelId}.

url.description: HTTP(S) origin without path, query, fragment, or credentials.

enumDescriptions: Off: web-search requests fail and no search service is contacted.
Exa: works without a key (rate-limited); a key raises the limits.
Firecrawl: works without a key (rate-limited); a key raises the limits.
Jina AI Search: requires an API key.
Brave Search: requires an API key; URL fetch is not supported.
Kagi: search and URL fetch require an API key.
agentGateway.webSearch.provider.markdownDescription: Hosted web-search and URL-fetch engine (Gemini `urlContext` fetches pages through it). Use **Agent Gateway: Web Search and Fetch** to pick one and store its API key. While `none`, web-search requests fail and no search service is contacted.

agentGateway.webSearch.model.markdownDescription: Model for Gemini hosted-search side requests whose requested model does not exist (Gemini CLI's `google_web_search` asks for its own internal model). Empty uses the model mappings: the best local Gemini Flash model, else the explicitly selected fallback model, if configured.

agentGateway.modelMappings.title: Model Mappings
agentGateway.modelMappings.markdownDescription: Model mappings: requested model name -> local model ID, for every protocol. This routes a requested name to another model; it does not select the agent's main model. Built-in defaults map the internal names of Gemini CLI and Antigravity CLI (`gemini-3-flash-preview`, `gemini-2.5-flash`, `gemini-2.5-flash-lite`, `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` -> best local Gemini Flash model; `gemini-3-pro-preview`, `gemini-2.5-pro` -> best local Gemini Pro model; else the fallback model) when that name has no route. An empty string disables a default. Substitutions are logged and reported in the `x-agent-gateway-model-fallback` header; aliases are not listed in `/v1/models`.

agentGateway.fallbackModel.markdownDescription: Local or remote upstream model used when an agent requests an unknown model name (Gemini requests excepted). Remote IDs use `{name}--{modelId}`. Empty disables fallback. No model is selected automatically. If the selected model is unavailable or does not support the requested API, the request fails. A matching `agentGateway.modelMappings` entry takes precedence. **Status** shows the fallback model in use.

agentGateway.webSearch.maxSearchesPerReq.markdownDescription: Most provider searches one hosted web-search request may run (Anthropic, OpenAI Responses and Gemini). A lower `max_uses` (Anthropic) or `max_tool_calls` (Responses) in the request wins. Searches the model asks for in one turn run in parallel; extra calls get a limit error so the model answers with what it has.

agentGateway.internal.strictProtocol.description: Internal/testing only: strict protocol validation in the new protocol core. Not for normal use.

scripts.build:prod: rimraf dist && pnpm run check-types && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.build:dev-variant: rimraf dist && pnpm run check-types && node esbuild.js --production --dev-variant
